name: Sunny Day Real Estate
label: Sub Pop
lede: Sunny Day Real Estate cut Diary in Chicago, gave out one interview and one photo to promote it, and split before the follow-up reached stores. Three reunions later, they're still on the road with it.

eras.title: Housemates, a drummer, and a singer from a side project
eras.text: Two University of Washington housemates and a drummer play instrumentals in grunge-era Seattle under three names. Jeremy Enigk arrives from the drummer's side band, and Sub Pop signs them soon after.

years.h: Dan Hoerner and Nate Mendel keep renaming their band
years.p: The University of Washington housemates recruit drummer [[William Goldsmith|585256d1-d013-409e-824d-0e4d847d8016]] and go through Empty Set, then Chewbacca Kaboom, then One Day I Stopped Breathing.
years.xp:
Mendel has said the final name was "just a random thought that popped into my head that came from a Talking Heads song." The song is (Nothing But) Flowers.

The trio began as an instrumental band until Hoerner took the mic. They self-released a 7-inch, Flatland Spider.

years.h: [[Jeremy Enigk|35058042-8310-4c5c-852c-f0ed011d77b0]] comes in through Goldsmith's side project
years.p: While Mendel tours with [[Christ on a Crutch|5c8c891c-04b5-49d1-94c2-2ed242a93df0]], Goldsmith starts Thief, Steal Me a Peach with his high school friend Enigk. Hoerner talks Mendel into letting Enigk join.
years.xp:
The side project's name lived on as the title of a 1993 7-inch. Its two songs, 8 and 9, came back as bonus tracks on the 2009 reissue of Diary.

Sub Pop's bio puts Enigk at 18 when he joined.

years.h: Jonathan Poneman signs them after their second show
years.p: The Sub Pop co-founder catches Sunny Day Real Estate at Seattle's Crocodile Cafe in May 1993 and signs them soon after.
years.xp:
Wikipedia dates the show to May 1993. Sub Pop's own bio calls it the band's second show ever.

Poneman told Sub Pop what hooked him: "the songs were so beautiful and evocative."

years.h: Brad Wood records Diary at Idful in Chicago
years.p: The sessions run in November 1993, with M. Casey Rice assisting Wood, who also engineers and mixes.
years.xp: The guitars owe debts the band has named: [[Fugazi|233fc3f3-6de2-465c-985e-e721dbabbace]]-style octave parts in 48 and Grendel, and Dan Hoerner's delay borrowed from U2's The Edge. Grendel takes its story from John Gardner's 1971 novel.

eras.title: Diary lands, then the band goes quiet
eras.text: Diary sells steadily for Sub Pop while the band says almost nothing and won't play California. By spring 1995 it has split, and the second album comes out into the silence.

years.h: Diary arrives with Little People on the cover
years.p: Released May 10, 1994. The butterfly in the booklet is a drawing by Nate Mendel's father, John Mendel.
years.xp:
Enigk has said the record was inspired by a high school girlfriend who broke his heart. In Circles started as his solo acoustic song before the band rebuilt it.

Diary never charted, but by 2008 it had sold more than 231,000 copies, seventh best in Sub Pop's history. AllMusic called it "arguably the definitive '90s emo album." Rolling Stone put it first on its 2016 list of the 40 greatest emo albums.

years.h: One interview, one photo, no California
years.p: Promoting Diary, the band allows one publicity photo, grants one interview, and refuses to play California without saying why.

yt: Seven, The Jon Stewart Show, September 1994
years.h: Seven goes on The Jon Stewart Show, then MTV
years.p: The lead single gets a slot with Stewart, and the band tapes songs for MTV's 120 Minutes.

years.h: Dave Grohl leaves a note for William Goldsmith
years.p: [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]], building [[Foo Fighters|67f66c07-6e61-4026-ade5-7e782fad3a5d]] after [[Kurt Cobain|3c9b356d-d1db-4f4e-a7a3-2d00c1d70255]]'s death, leaves it at a Sunny Day Real Estate show. Goldsmith calls back and signs on.
years.xp: Per Goldsmith's account, Grohl invited both Goldsmith and Mendel to join Foo Fighters in late October 1994, along with guitarist Pat Smear.

years.cap: Enigk, Hoerner and Mendel live, c. 1994
yt: Full set, the Black Cat, Washington DC, December 16, 1994
years.h: Out on the road with Shudder to Think and Soul Coughing
years.p: The U.S. tour closes out 1994. Goldsmith later said the split was planned before it began.

years.h: Dan Hoerner won't play KROQ's Almost Acoustic Christmas
years.p: Asked to do the Los Angeles radio show, he says no. Enigk, Mendel and Goldsmith play it as a trio.

years.big: "I was young and I had just experienced a major spiritual explosion"
years.h: Sunny Day Real Estate announce the end, one album in
years.p: Jeremy Enigk, in Sub Pop's bio, on the conversion to Christianity everyone seized on. The band later played the rumor down.
years.xp:
Enigk answered the rumors in a letter to a fan, writing that he had called on God and that his pain was gone. In June 2020, Goldsmith told the This Was The Scene podcast the split was mostly about the band's lack of success and Enigk's wish to leave, and that it was planned before the first U.S. tour.

Sub Pop's bio dates the end to spring 1995 and points to internal tensions.

years.h: Mendel and Goldsmith become Grohl's rhythm section
years.p: Foo Fighters tour in 1995 in support of [[Mike Watt|568203ae-c27b-4990-8997-09c0d5c0de77]] with Nate Mendel on bass and William Goldsmith on drums.

years.h: LP2 comes out pink, with no art and no liner notes
years.p: Released November 7, 1995. When Sub Pop asked for artwork, Goldsmith suggested a plain pink cover.
years.xp:
Enigk later said of the sleeve: "We put no energy into the artwork or into anything." Several songs have no real lyrics at all: he sang sounds, not words.

Sales lagged well behind Diary, and the record's following grew later, according to Sub Pop.

eras.title: Foo Fighters takes two, then gives one back
eras.text: Enigk goes solo, Hoerner takes to a farm, and Mendel and Goldsmith join Foo Fighters. Then Goldsmith's drums get re-recorded behind his back, and a Sub Pop rarities album talks the rest into reuniting.

years.h: Jeremy Enigk goes solo with Return of the Frog Queen
years.p: Dan Hoerner, meanwhile, retreats to a farm in rural Washington.

years.cap: Foo Fighters at the Phoenix Festival, with Dave Grohl and Nate Mendel on stage
years.h: Dave Grohl re-records Goldsmith's drums and doesn't tell him
years.p: The band redoes The Colour and the Shape in Los Angeles with Grohl on drums. Goldsmith hears it from Mendel and quits.
years.xp:
Goldsmith recalled: "Dave had me do 96 takes of one song, and I had to do thirteen hours' worth of takes on another one." He also said it seemed nothing he did was good enough.

He was offered the touring drummer job, felt betrayed, and left. Taylor Hawkins took the seat; Mendel stayed.

years.h: Sub Pop asks for rarities and gets a reunion
years.p: Enigk and Hoerner decide to cut new songs instead, and find the old fights have faded.
years.xp: The rarities would have included early 7-inches and a song made for The Crow: City of Angels soundtrack that went unused. Mendel planned to leave Foo Fighters to rejoin, hesitated for months, then turned it down just before recording.

eras.title: Round two, without Mendel
eras.text: The reunited trio makes two records, falls out with Sub Pop over a live album, and signs to a BMG-distributed label with big hopes. In 2001 the band ends again and a new one starts.

years.h: How It Feels to Be Something On brings the band back
years.p: Former Mommyheads bassist Jeff Palmer takes Mendel's spot. The title track and Every Shining Time You Arrive were written for Enigk's second solo album.
years.xp: Hoerner's song 100 Million carries his environmental politics. Palmer didn't last: Joe Skyward replaced him on bass.
play: How It Feels to Be Something On

years.h: Live sours the band on Sub Pop
years.p: Sub Pop releases one show on audio and one on video. The band says it got no final say on the artwork or the mixes, and with its contract fulfilled, it leaves.

years.cap: Enigk at the Axis, Boston, July 6, 2000
yt: One, live at the Palace, Los Angeles, 2000
years.h: Time Bomb Recordings puts out The Rising Tide
years.p: Engineer Lou Giordano, a longtime [[Hüsker Dü|5c4c90a4-539f-4101-83cf-301bc6a94e06]] collaborator, records it. [[Greg Suran|f4811d13-3a5b-4015-8a6e-b318ef39fa1e]] joins on guitar and a lengthy U.S. tour follows.

years.h: Second breakup, and the next band is The Fire Theft
years.p: Enigk, Goldsmith and Mendel start over under a new name rather than keep the old one.
years.xp: Mendel stayed in Foo Fighters and played with The Fire Theft when his schedule allowed. Their self-titled album came out in 2003. Enigk's solo album World Waits followed on October 17, 2006, on his own Lewis Hollow Records.

eras.title: The original four return, and the fifth album doesn't
eras.text: The first lineup reunites after fourteen years apart, plays Europe for the first time, and starts a fifth album. The record never appears, and in 2018 the drummer says where he thinks it went.

years.h: A Seattle DJ confirms the original four are back
years.p: After reports in April, Andrew Harms of 107.7 The End says Enigk, Hoerner, Mendel and Goldsmith are together again.

years.cap: The reunited band on tour, September 2009
years.h: A secret show at Hell's Kitchen in Tacoma starts the reunion
years.p: It's their first show with the original lineup since 1995, and it kicks off a U.S. and Canada tour.
years.xp: On the tour they often played a new song called 10. On September 29 they played Seven on Late Night with Jimmy Fallon.

years.h: Sub Pop remasters Diary and LP2
years.p: Both come back with bonus tracks and new liner notes. Diary adds 8 and 9 from the Thief, Steal Me a Peach 7-inch.

years.h: Volcanic ash cancels Belgium, so Europe starts in Barcelona
years.p: Soundwave in Australia in February, then Coachella. Ash scrubs their Groezrock set; they debut in Europe at Primavera Sound on May 29 and play London's HMV Forum on May 31.

years.h: The fifth album falls apart
years.p: Hoerner told Australia's FasterLouder recording would start in May 2010. Mendel said in 2013 that the sessions just fell apart.

years.h: "Lipton Witch" ends a 14-year wait for new music
years.p: It comes out in April for Record Store Day, sharing a 7-inch with [[Circa Survive|a2496a3c-8f42-4b98-b780-6f8d64f56441]].

years.big: "silenced, abandoned and buried within the murkiest depths of David Grohl's sock drawer"
years.h: A Facebook post reopens the fifth-album fight
years.p: Goldsmith's December 2018 post says the unfinished record was left at Grohl's Studio 606. Nate Mendel, through Foo Fighters' representatives, denies it.
years.xp:
Goldsmith said Jeremy Enigk never got the moral support or engineering he deserved at Studio 606, and claimed Grohl disapproved of Mendel's time in The Fire Theft and so opposed finishing the record.

Goldsmith replied to Mendel's denial that the two hadn't spoken since 2011, when a planned conference call about finishing the album never happened.

eras.title: Back from Spokane, without Mendel
eras.text: Three originals and a new bassist start the third reunion in a club Hoerner co-owns. It brings a 30th-birthday tour for Diary and the first new song in years.

years.h: A third reunion starts with Chris Jordan in for Mendel
years.p: Spin confirms Enigk, Hoerner and Goldsmith are back, with Jordan on bass and Greg Suran returning on guitar. A tour with [[The Appleseed Cast|61386f55-12b6-45be-baf2-7c9406965808]] is announced in May.

years.h: The first show back is at the club Hoerner co-owns
years.p: The Big Dipper in Spokane, Washington, hosts the band's return on September 10, 2022.

years.h: "Novum Vetus," a 1998 song, finally comes out
years.p: Teased with a tugboat drawing on Instagram, it dates from the How It Feels to Be Something On sessions.
years.xp: The release features Enigk, Hoerner and Goldsmith with Jordan on bass and Suran on guitar.

years.h: Diary turns 30 with a pearlescent reissue and a tour
years.p: The remastered, expanded edition comes back on May 10, 2024, and the anniversary tour runs through October 19.
years.xp:
The reissue adds two bonus tracks to the original eleven. The band headlined the first Best Friends Forever festival in Las Vegas and played Bourbon and Beyond in Louisville on September 22, and several tour dates sold out.

They also played Deftones' Dia de los Deftones in San Diego that year.

years.h: The 2025 tour pulls songs from every record, not just Diary
years.p: Dates run from Montreal on May 28 to Outbreak Fest in Manchester on June 14, then September 3 to 24 across the West, in cities earlier reunion tours skipped.
years.xp: The band said it plans on "celebrating songs from all of our records and more." The June run includes London on June 13.
